## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Per-fetch telemetry — each fetch inside a target run records
   `{host, url (S-6-gated), status, bytes, fetched_at, duration_ms,
   outcome}`; unevidenced fields absent, never zero-shaped; refusal /
   challenge / rights-reservation / robots / transport outcomes
   carried honestly.
2. The upstream-count pair (SIG-CONF-009) — the upstream's own count
   at fetch where exposed (`not_exposed` recorded, never a guess) vs
   the subjects held after the run, per target plus a run-level pair;
   `difference_pct` + closed classification; explained differences
   carry the closed reason vocabulary (`filtered`, `withheld_rows`,
   `pagination_cap`, `upstream_misreport`, `other:<class>`); an
   unexplained difference is recorded `unexplained` with its
   percentage — the >1 % fail rule binds where the check machinery
   reads it.
3. The SIG-INGEST-004 binding-version test — the logical claim
   identity includes `extractor_version` + `normalizer_version`; the
   withheld amendment is not applied; the versions bind into identity
   (`sig.claim-payload/2`) — new minting only, no stored row
   re-minted.
4. Schema — one new sqitch change (`deploy`/`revert`/`verify` + plan
   entry in dependency order); the report writer stays
   migration-compatible (a spine without the column writes the row
   without the field, never fails).
5. GQ-19 — real evaluator replacing the seam deferral; report mode
   kept; `not_evaluable` on missing surface/zero pairs, never a
   vacuous pass.
6. Stamps — `SIG-CONF-009` + `SIG-INGEST-004` in `pr/P35.34.md`.
